info.title: SmartForce 360 API
info.description: Generated from the route registry. Every route lists its permission, scope, audit action and rate class.

get.summary: Own in-app notifications

post.summary: Mark all own notifications as read
Mark one notification as read

get.summary: Delivery state per notification and channel (no message bodies)

post.summary: Sign in with tenant, identifier and password
Complete sign-in with a TOTP or single-use recovery code
Start voluntary MFA enrolment for the signed-in user

x-audit.none: creates a short-lived challenge only; enrolment itself is audited

post.summary: Create a TOTP secret for the pending login
Verify the first TOTP code, activate MFA and return single-use recovery codes
Rotate the refresh token; reuse of a rotated token revokes the family

x-audit.none: routine token rotation; reuse of a rotated token is audited as a security event

post.summary: Revoke the current session
Activate an account with a single-use, expiring code and set a password
Request a password reset link (always answers the same way)
Set a new password with a single-use token; revokes all sessions
Change own password; other sessions are revoked
Send a single-use verification link to own email address
Verify an email address with a single-use token

get.summary: Profile, permissions, scope and privacy-notice status
List sessions (own, or another user with session.revoke)

post.summary: Reset another user's MFA (never your own)
Unlock a locked account
Platform staff sign-in (MFA always required)
Create a TOTP secret for a platform user
Complete platform sign-in with TOTP
Create a Platform Super Admin account with the one-time setup code (first run) or an invitation code; the role is set by the server

get.summary: Whether Create account needs a setup/invitation code and whether 2FA is asked (simple local mode)

post.summary: Invite another Platform Super Admin; the one-time code is returned once and expires in 72 h

get.summary: Pending Super Admin invitations

x-audit.none: pending invitation list; codes are never returned again

get.summary: Platform user profile

post.summary: End the platform session
Change your own platform password (current password required); other sessions are signed out

get.summary: Platform accounts with status, roles, 2FA and lock state

post.summary: Deactivate another platform account (signs it out; never yourself or the last active Super Admin)
Re-activate a platform account
Reset another admin's 2FA after a lost phone (they set it up again at next sign-in)
Unlock a platform account locked by failed sign-ins

get.summary: Tenant list: state, plan and usage metadata only

post.summary: Provision a tenant in one idempotent transaction

x-audit.none: tenant.provision is written inside the provisioning transaction

get.summary: Tenant metadata

post.summary: Tenant lifecycle: suspend
Tenant lifecycle: resume
Tenant lifecycle: archive

put.summary: Assign a plan manually (no payment is taken or implied)

get.summary: Accounts of an organisation: name, username, email, roles, status (no password data)

post.summary: Set a new password for an organisation account (generated unless given); returned once; signs the user out and unlocks the account

get.summary: Plan catalogue
Platform health: store, queues, realtime, integrations (secrets masked)
Usage per tenant (counts only)

post.summary: Request time-boxed, read-only access to tenant content (or break-glass with Owner notification)

get.summary: Organisation profile

patch.summary: Update organisation profile, timezone, week and digit settings

get.summary: Effective settings with defaults and the current version

put.summary: Replace settings overrides; creates a new audited version

get.summary: Settings version history
Terminology labels (EN/AR)

x-audit.none: read of label data within scope

get.summary: Onboarding checklist computed from real data

post.summary: Record go-live confirmation

get.summary: Current usage against plan limits and monthly snapshots

x-audit.none: read of usage data within scope

get.summary: Plan and subscription state (no payment data is held)
Support-access requests and grants

post.summary: Owner decision on a support grant: approve
Owner decision on a support grant: deny
Owner decision on a support grant: revoke
Request tenant deletion after the grace period (blocked by legal hold)

get.summary: Deletion requests and their state

delete.summary: Cancel a pending deletion during the grace period

get.summary: Legal holds

post.summary: Place a legal hold that suspends deletion for a scope
Release a legal hold
Transfer ownership to another active member

get.summary: Integration status; secret values are never returned

put.summary: Enable, disable or configure an integration (secrets are write-only)

get.summary: User accounts with membership, lock and MFA state
Catalogue of permission keys
Roles with their permission keys

post.summary: Create a custom role, usually by cloning a default

get.summary: Role detail

x-audit.none: read of role data within scope

patch.summary: Edit a custom role (defaults are fixed: clone to customise)

get.summary: Membership roles and scope

patch.summary: Change a member's roles and hierarchy scope (takes effect on the next request)

get.summary: Organisation units within the caller's scope

post.summary: Create an organisation unit under a parent

get.summary: Unit detail

x-audit.none: read of unit data within scope

patch.summary: Rename a unit or change its code/status

post.summary: Move a unit; descendant paths are recomputed atomically and cycles are rejected
Merge a unit into another: posts, staff, teams and child units move; the source is archived

get.summary: Posts (sites) within scope

post.summary: Create a post belonging to exactly one unit

get.summary: Post detail

x-audit.none: read of post data within scope

get.summary: Teams within scope with member ids

post.summary: Create a team in a unit

put.summary: Replace team members (a person may be in several teams)

get.summary: Staff members within scope

post.summary: Create a staff member with a sign-in identity (email optional)

get.summary: Staff member profile (sensitive fields masked by role)

x-audit.none: read of staff data within scope

post.summary: Staff lifecycle: suspend
Staff lifecycle: reinstate
Staff lifecycle: offboard
Issue a single-use activation code (shown once) or email invitation
Validate a staff CSV and preview per-row results without changing data
Import staff from CSV with a per-row success/failure report; re-running the same file creates nothing new
Bulk update with one audit summary listing the affected count

get.summary: Timeline of assignments, attendance, checkpoint events and incidents within scope
Devices of staff within scope
Device detail with last health report

post.summary: Bind a device key pair (generated on the device) to the signed-in staff member
Approve a pending device; older devices beyond the policy maximum are revoked
Revoke a device (own device, or any in scope with device.manage); blocks all API access from it
Device health: battery, network, permission and background-restriction state, integrity review signals

get.summary: Sampling profile, thresholds, minimum app version and notice version for the device
Current privacy notice (localised) and whether the caller has accepted it
All notice versions with acceptance counts

post.summary: Publish a new notice version; staff must re-acknowledge before tracking
Record acceptance of a notice version (version, time, device)

get.summary: What is collected, whether tracking is active, own recent locations and attendance
Who accessed the caller's location history, when and why

post.summary: Export every data class held about one person
Delete or pseudonymise a person's data, honouring legal hold and retention

get.summary: Shift definitions within scope

post.summary: Create a shift definition with optional recurrence (RRULE subset)

get.summary: Shift detail

x-audit.none: read of shift data within scope

patch.summary: Update a shift definition (existing occurrences and assignments keep their times)

get.summary: Concrete occurrences for a date range (UTC instants, local date)
Assignments within scope, filterable by time, unit, post, staff and state

post.summary: Assign a staff member to a shift occurrence at a post (draft until the roster is published)

get.summary: Assignment detail with change history (own published assignment, or any in scope with assignment.read)

patch.summary: Change or reassign a scheduled assignment; a reason is mandatory and history is kept

post.summary: Cancel an assignment (closes tracking if the duty had started)
Staff member acknowledges a published assignment

get.summary: Current and upcoming published assignments with everything needed offline

post.summary: Publish a roster for a unit and period: creates an immutable version with a diff and notifies affected staff

get.summary: Roster version history with actor and time
One immutable roster version with its snapshot and diff

post.summary: Cancel a published roster version: its unstarted assignments are cancelled and staff are notified

get.summary: Understaffed shifts, unassigned posts and coverage percentage for a period

post.summary: Start duty: validates assignment, window, device, notice and geofence policy; opens the Tracking Session
End duty: records check-out and closes the Tracking Session
Break start / break end as separate, auditable events

get.summary: Attendance events within scope (device time and server receipt time both shown)

post.summary: Staff member requests a correction with a reason

get.summary: Correction requests: own, or within scope for reviewers

post.summary: Resubmit a returned correction with clarification
Approve, reject or return a correction; approval appends a correction event referencing the original

get.summary: Duty summary: scheduled vs actual, breaks, checkpoints, exceptions, coverage and missing evidence, each basis-labelled

post.summary: Supervisor review of a completed duty: approve (locks the summary) or return for clarification
Ingest up to 200 location points for an open Tracking Session; per-point results

x-audit.none: high-volume telemetry; rejections are counted in metrics and on the tracking session

get.summary: Latest state per staff member within scope, each with freshness and age

x-audit.none: live view; history access is audited separately

get.summary: Location history for one person in a time range; purpose is mandatory and every read is logged
Tracking sessions with open/close reasons and accepted/rejected counts

post.summary: Batch of queued offline events, validated individually in causal order with per-event results

get.summary: Events rejected at sync: gaps a supervisor needs to see
Geofences within scope (current versions unless history is requested)

post.summary: Create a circle or polygon geofence for a post

get.summary: Geofence detail

patch.summary: Edit a geofence: the old version is kept and a new version becomes active

get.summary: Entered/exited events with accuracy, confidence and policy version
Checkpoints within scope

post.summary: Create a checkpoint with an unguessable identifier (optionally a rotating code)
Issue a new identifier; the previous one stops working immediately

get.summary: Current rotating code for an on-site display

post.summary: Record a checkpoint scan; exactly one result with a stable reason code

x-audit.none: every scan attempt is itself an immutable record with its result

get.summary: Scan attempts with results
Expected checkpoint visits and their state

post.summary: Waive an expected checkpoint with a reason

get.summary: Server-sent event stream; rooms are computed by the server from the caller's scope
Events since a sequence number for reconnect without a full reload (bounded: 15 minutes / 10,000 events)
Alert rules with thresholds, severity, recipients and escalation

x-audit.none: read of rule data within scope

put.summary: Update a rule; the change is versioned and audited

get.summary: Escalation policies

post.summary: Create an escalation policy

get.summary: Alerts within scope, critical first
Alert with its full timeline

x-audit.none: read of alert data within scope

post.summary: Alert lifecycle: acknowledge (reason required for snooze and resolve)
Alert lifecycle: snooze (reason required for snooze and resolve)
Alert lifecycle: resolve (reason required for snooze and resolve)
Raise an SOS: creates a critical incident, notifies recipients and schedules escalation in one transaction

get.summary: Truthful delivery state of an SOS for the person who raised it

post.summary: Ask for an accidental SOS to be cancelled; it stays open until a dispatcher confirms
Report an incident with type, severity, description and optional location and attachments

get.summary: Incidents within scope (or own reports for field staff)
Incident detail with reporter, location age, responders and SOS delivery state

post.summary: Move an incident through its lifecycle; invalid transitions are rejected

get.summary: Active staff within scope who can be assigned as responders (name and code only)

x-audit.none: names of staff who can be assigned; needed by dispatchers without staff.read

post.summary: Assign responders from staff within scope; they are notified
Append a note (and attachments) to the immutable incident timeline

get.summary: Append-only incident timeline
Catalogue of reports the caller may run
Run a report with filters; every result states its as-of time, timezone, filters and basis labels

post.summary: Queue a CSV export with the same filters, definitions and basis labels as the on-screen report

get.summary: Own export jobs
Export state and, when ready, a short-lived download link (re-authorised on every request)

post.summary: Declare an upload and receive a short-lived upload URL

put.summary: Upload the file bytes; the server sniffs the real type, strips image metadata and stores a checksum

get.summary: Issue a short-lived signed download URL after re-checking authorisation
Download by signed URL

x-audit.none: bearer of a short-lived signed URL; issuing the URL is audited

get.summary: Search audit events by actor, action, resource and time; this read is itself audited
Verify the tenant's audit hash chain from its anchor
Retention period per data class and recent runs

post.summary: Run retention now, or dry-run to see what would be deleted

x-audit.none: retention.run / retention.dry_run is written by the run itself with per-class counts

post.summary: Owner requests a complete tenant export (JSON Lines per collection, manifest with checksums)

get.summary: Catalogue entries (incident types, duty types) with EN/AR labels

post.summary: Add a catalogue entry

patch.summary: Relabel or archive a catalogue entry (archived values stay valid on historical records)

get.summary: Operational overview for the caller's scope with data freshness
